title: Contains Duplicate
summary: Decide whether any value appears more than once in an array.

tests.explain: Only one distinct value, repeated: the first repeat is found at index 1.

hints: The brute force compares every pair of elements. What do you need to remember about the elements you have already seen to avoid that?
You only need to know whether a value has been seen before, not where or how often: a Set answers exactly that in O(1).
Walk the array once. If the current value is already in the set, return true; otherwise add it. If the loop ends, return false.

complexity.time: O(n): one pass with O(1) set lookups
complexity.space: O(n): the set can hold every value
